title: BizPrint (print-google-cloud-print-gcp-woocommerce) before 4.10.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in…
description: BizPrint (print-google-cloud-print-gcp-woocommerce) versions before 4.10.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in the Debug\Core component. This flaw allows any authenticated user, including those with the lowest Subscriber role, to invoke certain AJAX actions without proper nonce or capability checks. Exploitation can lead to unauthorized dispatch of print jobs for other customers' orders and disclosure of printer configuration, exposing personally identifiable information (PII) across customers and misuse of printer resources.
